m302-jobs.observed_description: An evening garden dinner under string lights with guests at long tables behind: a male waiter in a white shirt, black vest and long apron carrying plates; a female police officer in a plain dark-blue uniform and cap by a wooden gate; a female artist in a paint-stained apron painting on an easel; a bearded male singer singing into a stand microphone.
m302-jobs.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The badges on the cap and shirt are plain shapes with no writing.
